description: Groups report definitions (RDL or RDLC) by structure, to plan one change across many: a group's reports have the same items, datasets, parameters and code modules and differ only in places, texts and looks, so one set of operations naming their items changes them alike. Returns groups, the largest first: structure (edit_report's structure), roles (what role:signature and the like name there), differs (how its first report differs from the first group's), places (items placed otherwise), and versions: each report and its version.

detail.description: "full": each group's reports listed too, beside their versions.

reports.description: The reports by name: {"Receipt_de-CH.rdlc": "<the report's XML>", ...}; 50 at most, 20 MB in all.
